title: Surface area: every face counts
sentences: Surface area adds the areas of a solid's exposed surfaces.
A net unfolds a solid into flat shapes you can measure.
Total surface area includes bases; curved or lateral area excludes them.
Where two solids touch, their joined faces are hidden and should not be counted as exposed surface.
Find the surface area of a box 3 cm long, 2 cm wide, and 4 cm high.
lw = 6 cm², lh = 12 cm², and wh = 8 cm².
The box has two of each face, so SA = 2(6 + 12 + 8).
Use square units because this measures the outside surface.
